definitions.text_mt: Għemiż: l-att li wieħed jagħmeż b'għajnu.  it-tgħammiż
Għemża: tgħammiża waħda b'għajn, sinjal magħmul bl-għajn.

usage_examples.maltese: Għarajtu mill-għemiż li għamilli.
usage_examples.english: I recognised him from the wink he gave me.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-għemiż kontinwu jista' jkun sinjal nervuż.
usage_examples.english: Continuous winking can be a nervous sign.

definitions.text_mt: Għer: ħass l-għira jew ir-rgħiba lejn xi ħadd minħabba s-suċċess jew il-possedimenti tiegħu
Għer: ħass l-għira lejn xi ħadd minħabba dak li għandu jew dak li kiseb.

usage_examples.maltese: Kien jgħir għalih għax għandu karozza ġdida.
usage_examples.english: He was jealous of him because he has a new car.

usage_examples.maltese: Tgħirx għal ħaddieħor; kun kuntent b'dak li għandek.
usage_examples.english: Do not envy others; be happy with what you have.

definitions.text_mt: Ġudizzjali: li għandu x'jaqsam mal-ġudizzju, mal-qrati jew mal-amministrazzjoni tal-ġustizzja.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-qorti ħarġet deċiżjoni ġudizzjali importanti llum.
usage_examples.english: The court issued an important judicial decision today.

usage_examples.maltese: Is-sistema ġudizzjali Maltija hija bbażata fuq il-liġi Ingliża.
usage_examples.english: The Maltese judicial system is based on English law.

definitions.text_mt: Ġudizzjalment: b'mod li għandu x'jaqsam mal-ġudizzju jew mal-proċess legali.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-każ ġie deċiż ġudizzjalment mill-qorti tal-appell.
usage_examples.english: The case was decided judicially by the court of appeal.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-kwistjoni trid tiġi solvuta ġudizzjalment, mhux permezz tal-vjolenza.
usage_examples.english: The matter must be resolved judicially, not through violence.

definitions.text_mt: Ġudizzjarju: li għandu x'jaqsam mas-sistema tal-qrati, mal-imħallfin jew mal-amministrazzjoni tal-ġustizzja.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-poteri ġudizzjarji huma separati mill-poteri leġiżlattivi u eżekuttivi.
usage_examples.english: Judicial powers are separate from legislative and executive powers.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-karriera ġudizzjarja tiegħu bdiet meta nħatar imħallef.
usage_examples.english: His judicial career began when he was appointed judge.

definitions.text_mt: Ġudizzju: żmien twil ħafna, perjodu li jidher li ma jispiċċa qatt.

usage_examples.maltese: Ma narahx minn ġudizzju!
usage_examples.english: I haven't seen him for ages!

usage_examples.maltese: Dam ġudizzju sħiħ qabel ma wasal it-tweġiba.
usage_examples.english: It took a very long time before the answer arrived.

definitions.text_mt: Ġudizzju: il-kapaċità li wieħed jifhem, jagħraf u jiddeċiedi b'mod għaqli u raġonevoli; għaqal, prudenza, sens komun.
Ġudizzju: fehma, opinjoni jew evalwazzjoni fuq xi ħaġa jew xi ħadd.

usage_examples.maltese: Uża ġudizzju tajjeb meta tiddeċiedi x'se tagħmel.
usage_examples.english: Use good judgment when you decide what to do.

usage_examples.maltese: Skont il-ġudizzju tiegħi, din hija l-aħjar għażla.
usage_examples.english: In my judgment, this is the best choice.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġudizzju tal-esperti kien li l-proġett huwa fattibbli.
usage_examples.english: The experts' opinion was that the project is feasible.

definitions.text_mt: Ġudizzjuż: li juri ġudizzju tajjeb, għaqli u prudenti fid-deċiżjonijiet tiegħu.

usage_examples.maltese: Huwa raġel ġudizzjuż li dejjem jieħu deċiżjonijiet bil-għaqal.
usage_examples.english: He is a judicious man who always makes decisions wisely.

usage_examples.maltese: L-investitur ġudizzjuż ma jirriskjax il-flus kollha tiegħu f'daqqa.
usage_examples.english: A judicious investor does not risk all his money at once.

definitions.text_mt: Ġuf: l-organu riproduttiv fil-ġisem tal-mara u tal-annimali femminili fejn jikber il-fetu qabel it-twelid.

usage_examples.maltese: It-tarbija kienet għadha fil-ġuf ta' ommha.
usage_examples.english: The baby was still in its mother's womb.

usage_examples.maltese: L-ultrasound wera li l-ġuf kien b'saħħtu.
usage_examples.english: The ultrasound showed that the uterus was healthy.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġuf jespandi hekk kif it-tarbija tikber.
usage_examples.english: The womb expands as the baby grows.

definitions.text_mt: Ġuklar: mużiċist, kantant jew daffien vjaġġatur li kien idur minn post għall-ieħor biex jiddivertixxi lin-nies fi żminijiet medjevali.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġuklar kien idur il-bliet u jdaqq il-laħan bil-vjolin.
usage_examples.english: The jongleur would tour the towns and play tunes on the violin.

usage_examples.maltese: Fiż-żminijiet antiki, il-ġuklar kellu rwol importanti fid-divertiment tal-poplu.
usage_examples.english: In ancient times, the jongleur played an important role in entertaining the people.

definitions.text_mt: Ġukulier: varjant ortografiku ta' ġuklar, mużiċist jew kantant vjaġġatur medjevali.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġukulier kien jivvjaġġa minn raħal għall-ieħor b'daqquqa u kanzunetti.
usage_examples.english: The jongleur would travel from village to village with tunes and songs.

usage_examples.maltese: Ir-re kien iħobb il-poeżiji u l-kanzunetti tal-ġukulier.
usage_examples.english: The king loved the poems and songs of the jongleur.

definitions.text_mt: Ġulbiena: pjanta tal-ġeneru Vicia, il-frott tagħha jintuża bħala għalf għall-annimali.

usage_examples.maltese: Ir-raħħal ħalla l-għelieqi tal-ġulbiena għall-mogħoż.
usage_examples.english: The farmer left the vetch fields for the goats.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġulbiena tikber sew fl-art tal-ġir f'Malta.
usage_examples.english: Vetch grows well in the limestone soil of Malta.

definitions.text_mt: Ġulepp: xarba ħelwa li tikkonsisti minn meraq taz-zokkor imħallat ma' togħma ta' frott jew ħxejjex mediċinali.
Ġulepp: xi ħaġa li hija ħelwa żżejjed, speċjalment xarba.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġulepp tal-lumi jgħin kontra l-irjiħat.
usage_examples.english: Lemon julep helps against colds.

usage_examples.maltese: Dan il-kejk hu ġulepp; mhux se nkun nista' nieklu kollu.
usage_examples.english: This cake is too sweet; I won't be able to eat it all.

definitions.text_mt: Ġulġlien: żerriegħa żgħira użata bħala ħwawar jew biex jittieħed iż-żejt minnha.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ħobż bil-ġulġlien huwa wieħed mill-aktar tipi popolari f'Malta.
usage_examples.english: Sesame bread is one of the most popular types in Malta.

usage_examples.maltese: Iż-żejt tal-ġulġlien jintuża ħafna fil-kċina Asjatika.
usage_examples.english: Sesame oil is widely used in Asian cuisine.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-pastiċċi tal-ġulġlien huma tradizzjoni Maltija.
usage_examples.english: Sesame rings are a Maltese tradition.

definitions.text_mt: Ġummar: siġra tal-palm żgħira li tikber fl-Ewropa u fl-Afrika ta' Fuq, magħrufa xjentifikament bħala Chamaerops humilis.
Ġummar: għodda tad-dar magħmula mill-weraq tal-palm, użata għat-tfittix jew it-tindif.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġummar jikber fis-selvaġġ f'Malta u madwar il-Mediterran.
usage_examples.english: The European fan palm grows wild in Malta and around the Mediterranean.

usage_examples.maltese: Ommi kienet tuża l-ġummar biex tiknes il-bitħa.
usage_examples.english: My mother used the broom to sweep the yard.

definitions.text_mt: Ġummiena: razzett jew mazz ta' ħjut jew suf imdendlin, użat bħala żejjen jew ornament.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-purtiera kellha ġmiemen tad-deheb fil-ġnub.
usage_examples.english: The curtain had golden tassels on the sides.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġummiena mal-kpiepel tal-istudenti kienet tradizzjoni fl-università.
usage_examples.english: The tassel on students' caps was a tradition at the university.

definitions.text_mt: Ġuna: basket maħdum bil-qasab jew bil-għadam użat għat-trobbija tal-ħut jew bħala nassa għall-ħut.

usage_examples.maltese: Is-sajjied niżel il-ġuna fil-baħar biswit ix-xatt.
usage_examples.english: The fisherman lowered the breeding basket into the sea near the shore.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ħut żgħir kien jinġabar fil-ġuna qabel jittieħed is-suq.
usage_examples.english: The small fish were collected in the basket before being taken to the market.

definitions.text_mt: Ġunjett: sinonimu antik ta' Lulju, is-seba' xahar tas-sena.

usage_examples.maltese: Fi żmien il-ġunanniet, Ġunjett kien xahar ta' sħana kbira.
usage_examples.english: In the old days, July was a month of great heat.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ħsad kien isir f'Ġunjett, qabel il-bidu tas-sajf.
usage_examples.english: The harvest used to take place in July, before the beginning of summer.

definitions.text_mt: Ġunju: is-sitt xahar tas-sena, li jiġi bejn Mejju u Lulju.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-festa ta' San Ġwann tiġi ċċelebrata f'Ġunju.
usage_examples.english: The feast of Saint John is celebrated in June.

usage_examples.maltese: F'Ġunju jsiru l-eżamijiet tat-tmiem is-sena fl-iskejjel.
usage_examples.english: In June, the end-of-year exams take place in schools.

usage_examples.maltese: Ġunju huwa xahar tal-bidu tas-sajf f'Malta.
usage_examples.english: June is the beginning of summer in Malta.

definitions.text_mt: Ġunġlien: varjant ortografiku ta' ġulġlien.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġunġlien jintuża fil-ħobż u fid-deżerti.
usage_examples.english: Sesame is used in bread and desserts.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġunġlien huwa żerriegħa li tagħti żejt bnin.
usage_examples.english: Sesame is a seed that gives a healthy oil.

definitions.text_mt: Ġurad: insett li jaqbeż u li għandu riġlejn twal, ta' lewn aħdar jew isfar, komuni fl-għelieqi.
Ġurad: tip ta' ġurat li jivvjaġġa fi swièm kbar u jikkawża ħsara lill-għelejjel.

usage_examples.maltese: Ra ġurad jaqbeż fost il-ħaxix fl-għelieqi.
usage_examples.english: He saw a grasshopper jumping among the grass in the fields.

usage_examples.maltese: Is-swièm tal-ġurad qerdu l-għelejjel kollha dik is-sena.
usage_examples.english: The swarms of locusts destroyed all the crops that year.

definitions.text_mt: Ġurament: wegħda solenni li wieħed jagħmel, spiss billi jsejjaħ lil Alla bħala xhud, speċjalment quddiem il-liġi.

usage_examples.maltese: Ix-xhud ħa l-ġurament qabel xehed fil-qorti.
usage_examples.english: The witness took the oath before testifying in court.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-President ħa l-ġurament tal-kariga quddiem il-Parlament.
usage_examples.english: The President took the oath of office before Parliament.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġurament huwa rabta solenni li wieħed ma jiksirx.
usage_examples.english: An oath is a solemn bond that one does not break.

definitions.text_mt: Ġurat: persuna maħtura bħala membru ta' ġurija f'proċess legali, li tiddeċiedi jekk akkużat huwiex ħati jew le.
Ġurat: varjant ortografiku ta' ġurad, insett li jaqbeż.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġurati ntgħażlu b'mod każwali mir-reġistru elettorali.
usage_examples.english: The jurors were selected randomly from the electoral register.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġurat kellu jisma' l-provi kollha qabel jagħti verdett.
usage_examples.english: The juror had to hear all the evidence before giving a verdict.

definitions.text_mt: Ġurdien: annimal żgħir tal-familja tar-rodituri, b'geddum bil-ponta, widnejn tondi u denb twil; komuni fid-djar u fl-għelieqi.
Ġurdien: annimal akbar tal-istess familja tar-rodituri, spiss meqjus bħala pesti.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-qtates jikkaċċjaw il-ġrieden fil-kampanja.
usage_examples.english: Cats hunt mice in the countryside.

usage_examples.maltese: Ra ġurdien jaħrab minn taħt il-kexxun tal-kċina.
usage_examples.english: She saw a mouse run from under the kitchen drawer.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġurdien tal-kampanja jiekol il-ħbub fl-għelieqi.
usage_examples.english: The field mouse eats the grains in the fields.

definitions.text_mt: Ġurdni: ta' lewn griż, kulur bejn l-abjad u l-iswed.

usage_examples.maltese: Iż-żiemel ġurdni kien jispikka fost iż-żwiemel l-oħra.
usage_examples.english: The grey horse stood out among the other horses.

usage_examples.maltese: Fil-Munxar, il-kelma 'ġurdni' tintuża fid-djalett lokali minflok 'griż'.
usage_examples.english: In Munxar, the word 'ġurdni' is used in the local dialect instead of 'griż'.

definitions.text_mt: Ġurnal: pubblikazzjoni ta' kuljum jew ta' kull ġimgħa li ġġib aħbarijiet, artikli u reklami.

usage_examples.maltese: Kull filgħodu huwa jaqra l-ġurnal waqt il-kolazzjon.
usage_examples.english: Every morning he reads the newspaper during breakfast.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġurnal tal-lum iġib l-aħbarijiet l-aktar importanti tal-ġurnata.
usage_examples.english: Today's newspaper brings the most important news of the day.

usage_examples.maltese: Ħafna nies qed jaqilbu mill-ġurnal stampat għal dak diġitali.
usage_examples.english: Many people are switching from the printed newspaper to the digital one.

definitions.text_en: day (period when a person is awake and experiences things)
definitions.text_mt: Ġurnata: il-perjodu ta' żmien meta persuna tkun imqajma u attiva, mill-qawmien sas-sodda.
Ġurnata: perjodu ta' żmien li jdum erbgħa u għoxrin siegħa, minn nofsillejl sas-siegħa ta' wara.
Ġurnata: il-perjodu ta' żmien bejn it-tlugħ u l-inżul tax-xemx.

usage_examples.maltese: Kellna ġurnata sabiħa fuq il-bajja.
usage_examples.english: We had a beautiful day at the beach.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġurnata għandha erbgħa u għoxrin siegħa.
usage_examples.english: A day has twenty-four hours.

usage_examples.maltese: Matul il-ġurnata, it-temperatura telgħet għal tletin grad.
usage_examples.english: During the daytime, the temperature rose to thirty degrees.

etymology_chain.definition: a male given name from Hebrew, equivalent to English John
a male given name, equivalent to English John

definitions.text_en: A male given name from Sicilian [in turn from Latin, in turn from Ancient Greek, in turn from Hebrew], equivalent to English John
definitions.text_mt: Ġwann: isem propju ta' raġel, l-ekwivalenti Malti ta' John.

usage_examples.maltese: Ġwann huwa isem komuni ħafna f'Malta.
usage_examples.english: John is a very common name in Malta.

usage_examples.maltese: San Ġwann il-Battista huwa l-patrun ta' bosta knejjes f'Malta.
usage_examples.english: Saint John the Baptist is the patron of many churches in Malta.

etymology_chain.definition: a male given name from Hebrew, equivalent to English John
a male given name, equivalent to English John

definitions.text_en: A male given name from Sicilian [in turn from Latin, in turn from Ancient Greek, in turn from Hebrew], equivalent to English John
definitions.text_mt: Ġwanni: varjant ortografiku ta' Ġwann, isem propju ta' raġel.

usage_examples.maltese: Ġwanni huwa varjant antik tal-isem Ġwann.
usage_examples.english: Ġwanni is an old variant of the name Ġwann.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-forma 'Ġwanni' tintuża f'xi dokumenti storiċi Maltin.
usage_examples.english: The form 'Ġwanni' is used in some Maltese historical documents.
